ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: The Forge
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
THEFORGE_RM_MOD_BUILD_1 (Phase A row 21 of design/RimMandrake/biome_mod_architecture.md). One mountain, three zones, and the only vertical skyline for a hundred kilometres: tall foundry towers streaming vent-steam, red lava seams and ash skirts below them, and vast placid herds drifting in the vapor columns above. The mountain rains on itself in scalding, closed bursts, and mosses drink in the seconds between fall and flash. It generalizes the biome sketched for a frozen campaign world's own volcanic massif (design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/the_forge.md) with zero campaign-specific content: no named factions, no lore proper nouns, nothing that names the source campaign or any franchise.
RM tier: nothing here knows what campaign or planet uses it. It ships its own signature flora (fire lavender, heatsink fungus, and a heat-hardened crust-fungus distinct from any other biome's own variant per biome_mod_architecture.md §7 Q13), its own closed boiling-rain weather cycle, its own red haze weather, and a modest core of non-franchise wildlife including a from-scratch fleet flier. Franchise-specific fauna (Star Wars creatures) never appear in this def; a companion Utinni patch layers three of them on top for the campaign that wants the fuller cast, exactly as it does with every other RimMandrake biome mod — and fixes a defName mismatch the frozen twin never had a chance to: the campaign's tibanna-tap mechanism targets the ported RSW_Beldon, but the twin's own wildAnimals spawned only the bare donor Beldon, so the tap's target never actually lived on this biome. This mod casts RSW_Beldon in the campaign patch instead.
Ships one real behaviour switch, togglable in Mod Settings (default = shipped behavior, MOD_OPTIONS_RETROFIT_1 doctrine):
1. The master toggle: turns this mod's own settings-driven behaviour off without touching the biome def itself — the massif, its plants and its animals keep loading and playing exactly as before.
The remaining toggles (weather-pulse bursts, tibanna-tap rate, vapor-column immunity, tower scatter count, die-off ring density, vent work-speed bonus) are scaffolding for FORGE_MECHANICS_1's shared mechanics, matching RM_TheRotSettings' own precedent: declared, exposed and shown in this screen, but not yet wired to change behaviour — that consolidation is owed alongside FORGE_MECHANICS_1's own remaining work, not this build.
NOT in this mod: the foundry tower dungeon shell, the Contagion die-off ring, the tibanna gas item and its gather mechanism, and the vent-industry buildings (RUT_VentSmelter/VentForge/VentKiln) — all named campaign plot or tracked separately under FORGE_MECHANICS_1, and land here later if that item's own split decides to move them.
